messages:
Priya: Heads-up 1: Customer 'Northpoint' wants to move their private pilot up 10 days and requires customer-managed KMS (HSM) + p95 < 350ms. Need fast triage of deps.
Owen: What QPS and model size? That dictates reserved slots and prewarm.
Priya: Expect peaks ~90 QPS, avg 25. Model: 13B but customer would accept 7B for speed.
Rina: Runtime: 7B + continuous batching + KV cache meets p95 easily. 13B will need extra slots or quantization. Need routing fallback if HSM not ready.
Mae: Infra: HSM onboarding + VPC peering is ~8 business days. Hosted-KMS fallback can be ready in ~3 working days if model/slots locked.
Priya: Options: A) Hold for HSM; B) Hosted-KMS fallback + 7B; C) 13B with hosted-KMS and larger reserved pool. Preference for fastest is B.
Owen: Agree. We'll document risk: keys not customer-managed. Also prepare cutover/runbook for later HSM swap.
Rina: I can prototype a routing policy and canary guard (p95 threshold) in 48h. Pseudocode: ``route -> if customer.hsm_ready then pool-hsm else pool-hosted-kms``
Mae: I'll estimate GPU slot delta for 13B vs 7B by EOD and queue infra reservation if we pick 13B.
Priya: Action list: Mae -> slot estimates (EOD). Rina -> routing prototype + perf (48h). Owen -> SOW update with fallback and acceptance criteria (today). Security checklist -> I'll pull in later. infra-bot: create ticket and schedule 30m sync.
infra-bot: Created ticket RDW-3091 "Northpoint private pilot: HSM/KMS gating" and scheduled meeting 1780026000 (3pm PT). Assigned: Priya, Owen, Rina, Mae.
Priya: Thanks all. If HSM slips, we default to hosted-KMS + 7B and notify customer with timeline and rollback plan. :thumbsup:
